alert_rules.message: GPS jamming: prefer passive/multidomain (SAR/ELINT) before heavy surface approach.
Pipeline corridor: coordinate national C2; avoid public-domain disclosure of exact segment.
Russian fleet proximity: passive ISR first; surface escalation requires explicit ROE gate.

coa_legal_notes.A: Multidomain cueing; share metadata under existing bilateral arrangements.
coa_legal_notes.B: Heavy surface + EO — confirm territorial sea / EEZ tasking.
coa_legal_notes.C: K130 + ALB — shallow-water only; depth and turbidity gates apply.
